job.title: Research Lead - Evaluations
job.description: <strong>Company Description<br><br></strong><strong>Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.<br><br></strong>Servus, hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!<br><br>Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.<br><br><strong>Where And How You Can Work<br><br></strong>Our flagship campus is in Sydney, Australia but London is home to part of our European operations. And you have choice in where and how you work, we trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals.<br><br>Fun fact, a big part of our Austrian operations is developing the AI product within Canva to help reimagine how artificial intelligence can be used in design. Pretty cool ha!<br><br><strong>Job Description<br><br></strong>As Canva grows, so does the impact and opportunity of our AI-powered features. We’re looking for a Research Lead to coach a team of world-class scientists, build on our foundational model roadmap, and turn academic breakthroughs into delightful product experiences. If you thrive in bridging deep research with practical application, and you love helping others grow while solving hard technical problems—this could be the role for you.<br><br><strong>About The Role<br><br></strong>You will lead and grow a team of high-performing research scientists who are advancing the future of AI at scale. Your focus will be on setting strategic research direction, coaching others to deliver impactful scientific contributions, and ensuring the translation of research into meaningful product capabilities. You’ll champion both scientific excellence and scalable impact, bridging foundational model innovation with real-world deployment across Canva’s platform.<br><br>This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is passionate about cultivating talent, shaping a research vision, and partnering cross-functionally to embed cutting-edge AI into delightful user experiences.<br><br><strong>At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On<br><br></strong><ul><li>Coaching and mentoring a high-performing team of research scientists and machine learning engineers.</li><li>Owning the evaluation strategy - Design and run robust evaluation frameworks—quality, safety, red-teaming, competitive benchmarking—to guarantee enterprise readiness and user delight at scale.</li><li>Setting research strategy in alignment with Canva’s AI and product goals.</li><li>Guiding technical direction across foundational model development, experimentation, and evaluation.</li><li>Partnering cross-functionally to ensure research translates into product impact.</li><li>Representing Canva in the global AI community through publications, talks, or open-source contributions.<br><br><br></li></ul><strong>You’re Probably a Match If You<br><br></strong><ul><li>Have led research or applied science teams, with a strong track record of coaching and impact.</li><li>Possess expert knowledge and experience with GANs, Diffusion Models, VAEs, and Autoregressive Models.</li><li>Possess deep, hands-on expertise in training and evaluating generative models (Diffusion, GANs, VAEs, LLMs).</li><li>Excel at creating data-driven evaluation methodologies, turning user analytics into clear, actionable insights.</li><li>Bring strategic thinking and scientific rigour to project direction and problem solving.</li><li>Thrive in collaborative environments and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.</li><li>Stay current with research trends and are energised by continuous learning.<br><br><br></li></ul><strong>Additional Information<br><br></strong><strong>What's in it for you?<br><br></strong>Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.<br><br><strong>Here's a Taste Of What's On Offer<br><br></strong><ul><li>Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too</li><li>Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents &amp; carers</li><li>An annual Vibe &amp; Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, home office setup &amp; more</li><li>Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally<br><br><br></li></ul>Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.<br><br><strong>Other Stuff To Know<br><br></strong>We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.<br><br>Please note that interviews are predominantly conducted virtually.

job.title: Senior Engineering Manager
job.description: <p><strong>Engineering Manager – AI &amp; Agent Systems (London)</strong></p><p><br></p><p>A fast-growing AI company is opening a new London office and looking for an <strong>Engineering Manager</strong> to lead a team building cutting-edge agentic and conversational AI systems used by major global brands.</p><p><br></p><p>This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working hands-on with complex systems, mentoring engineers, and partnering directly with customers to turn real-world challenges into scalable technical solutions.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p><ul><li>Lead and grow a high-performing engineering team.</li><li>Deliver AI-driven agents that manage sophisticated customer interactions at scale.</li><li>Work closely with product, research, and enterprise customers to shape platform direction.</li><li>Take ownership of technical decisions, system reliability, and continuous improvement.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>What you bring</strong></p><ul><li>2+ years of engineering leadership experience.</li><li>7+ years in software engineering.</li><li>Strong skills in Python, TypeScript, and asynchronous programming.</li><li>Ability to dive deep into complex systems and drive high-quality execution.</li><li>(Bonus) Experience with multimodal models or AI systems.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Why this role</strong></p><ul><li>Build a new engineering hub from the ground up.</li><li>High-impact work on AI systems used by millions.</li><li>Collaborative, fast-moving, in-office environment.</li><li>Competitive benefits, flexible time off, and daily meals.</li></ul><p></p>

job.title: Director of Platform Engineering
job.description: <p><strong>Director of Platform Engineering | Fintech | London Hybrid</strong></p><p><br></p><p>A global fintech who's technology powers eading e-commerce, payments, and tech brands is looking for a <strong>Director of Platform Engineering</strong> to help drive the next stage of platform and team maturity.</p><p><br></p><p>This role sits at the intersection of <strong>technical depth</strong> and <strong>hands-on leadership</strong>, with a blend of:</p><p>Strong engineering foundations across high-performance platforms, microservices, API-driven development, and distributed systems.</p><p>AND</p><p>Leading and developing teams. The current Platform group is ~25 people. You’ll shape the structure, strengthen collaboration, and support a high-performance culture.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p><ul><li>Evolving cloud-native infrastructure that’s secure, scalable, and resilient.</li><li>Ensuring the Platform Team adds maximum value across the breadth of the business. </li><li>Helping shape an engineering culture focused on clarity, velocity, and collaboration.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p><ul><li>Solid cloud and platform engineering experience (AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC).</li><li>Proven leadership within platform or infrastructure teams.</li><li>A strategic approach to scaling systems in complex environments.</li><li>Experience in high-growth, product-led businesses (fintech helpful but not essential).</li></ul><p></p>

job.title: SVP Engineering
job.description: <p>The Senior Vice President (SVP) of Engineering is a pivotal executive role, reporting into our Chief Technology &amp; Product Officer. The role is responsible for leading the globally distributed engineering organisations through a dual transformation: evolving the business from an academic publisher to a Knowledge Marketplace, while simultaneously pivoting the technology function toward AI-First Software Engineering.</p><p><br></p><p>This role requires a leader who is a strategist, an expert in modern engineering, and is aware of how to embed AI across the entire software lifecycle. You will be responsible for the technology strategy that powers our marketplace, balancing the need for robust distributed systems with the agility required to experiment and grow. You will partner closely with Product leadership to co-create solutions that solve complex user problems.</p><p><br></p><p>The role will work to bridge geographies and time zones, championing Distributed Agile practices that allow our global teams to collaborate seamlessly. You will embed AI-assisted development (e.g., Copilot, code generation, automated refactoring) into the core of our SDLC, amplifying the productivity of our global teams and defining the future of our engineering workforce. You will champion Distributed Agile practices that bridge time zones and instil a culture of technical excellence rooted in Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Continuous Delivery. This role demands a visionary leader who can balance technical innovation with business priorities to achieve sustainable growth and competitive advantage.</p><p><br></p><p>The Academic Publishing industry and T&amp;F are on an exciting growth agenda; from a portfolio of separate products to an integrated platform with a focus on leveraging emerging technologies to ensure advanced substantiated knowledge is accessible and can have real world impact. This role ensures that the company achieves its long-term goals and remains competitive in a dynamic business environment.</p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>Key Responsibilities and Accountability: </u></strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Technology Strategy &amp; Architecture</strong></p><ul><li>Define and execute a scalable engineering strategy to transition the business to a platform model, leveraging modern architectures like Event-Driven Architecture and Microservices.</li><li>Ensure systems support high-traffic marketplace scalability, balancing speed-to-market with long-term differentiation.</li><li>Build strong relationships with stakeholders, translating business vision into technical delivery while effectively communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Modern Engineering Excellence</strong></p><ul><li>Embed AI-first engineering practices to enhance developer productivity and ensure secure, high-quality AI-generated code.</li><li>Drive Continuous Delivery and DevOps maturity using DORA metrics to achieve high-velocity, high-quality outputs.</li><li>Modernize legacy systems by migrating to cloud-native architectures without disrupting business operations.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Product Engineering Partnership</strong></p><ul><li>Collaborate with Product leadership to align engineering with product discovery and commercial outcomes.</li><li>Shorten feedback loops to enable rapid testing and iteration, ensuring technical decisions enhance marketplace performance and customer satisfaction.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Team Development &amp; Culture</strong></p><ul><li>Build a cohesive, high-performing engineering team, fostering ownership, inclusivity, and continuous learning.</li><li>Lead AI upskilling programs and attract top-tier talent in modern stacks, distributed systems, and AI engineering.</li><li>Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion while mentoring leaders to balance technical expertise with people management.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Stakeholder Collaboration</strong></p><ul><li>Act as a liaison between engineering and other departments, ensuring alignment across the organization.</li><li>Represent engineering in executive meetings and external engagements, providing strategic insights and recommendations.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Creativity &amp; Technology Leadership</strong></p><ul><li>Champion emerging technologies and foster a culture of experimentation to maintain a competitive edge.</li><li>Identify industry trends and opportunities to inform strategic decisions and align with customer aspirations.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Experience &amp; Knowledge </strong></p><p><br></p><ul><li>Modern Engineering Practitioner: Proven deep, hands-on background in software engineering with a philosophy rooted in TDD, CI/CD, and Agile XP (Extreme Programming) principles. Understanding of "good" software and solutions. Crucially, you have practical experience of AI tools and understand the impact this has on productivity and crucially on code quality.</li><li>Distributed Systems: Proven experience architecting and managing complex Distributed Systems and Cloud-Native architectures (AWS/Azure/GCP). You understand the complexities of building a multi-sided global marketplace.</li><li>Marketplace/Platform Context: Experience building platforms that support B2B or B2C marketplaces, or complex content ecosystems, is highly desirable.</li><li>Global Leadership: Experience leading large-scale, globally distributed engineering teams. You have a playbook for managing distributed agile at scale, handling cultural nuances, and synchronizing delivery across time zones.</li><li>Strategic Transformation: Demonstrated history of leading engineering teams through transformations from legacy methods to modern, automated, and AI-enhanced workflows.</li><li>Product Fluency: You speak "Product." You have experience working in a "Triad" model (Engineering, Product, Delivery) and understand how to balance technical debt reduction with feature delivery.</li><li>Holistic business knowledge with an understanding of the operational complexities of large multinational organisations particularly of a matrix organisational structure.</li><li>Mature and proactive attitude, with excellent judgment and problem-solving skills</li><li>A flexible and agile mentality able to quickly adapt and respond to changing work pressures and prioritises</li><li>Excellent communication and influencing skills with the ability to present and drive change with stakeholders at all levels of the business.</li><li>A curious outlook – known for asking the right questions of the right stakeholders.</li><li>Highly collaborative, emotionally intelligent and someone people are excited to work with; also having strong personal influencing skills</li><li>Extremely well organised and comfortable managing a significant and varied workload across global time zones that needs constant prioritisation.</li><li>Numerate with an ability to interpret and understand project plans, budgets, and financial targets; Ability to analyse and compile a large amount of data and come up with conclusive results</li><li>Commercially minded with strong financial acumen and a dedicated customer focussed attitude</li><li>Demonstrated commercial acumen and results orientation.</li><li>Programme management skills with a proven ability to get things done, not deterred by the changing or evolving nature of a project.</li></ul><p><br></p><p>We ask that candidates live within a reasonable commuting distance of our office in either Milton Park Oxfordshire (OX14) or London Blackfriars to enable you to <strong><u>collaborate in person at least 3 days per week.</u></strong></p><p><br></p><p>Taylor &amp; Francis is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you have a disability, or face another barrier, and would like to request an adjustment to assist your participation in the hiring process and/or in the advertised position, please contact recruitment@tandf.co.uk. Your request will be reviewed and considered in the strictest confidence.</p>
